name: Elixir
description: Elixir, EEx and HEEx: highlighting, and the language server (Expert where installed, ElixirLS otherwise) for completion, hover, definition, diagnostics and formatting

expert.name: Expert
expert.install: Download the release for your platform from https://github.com/expert-lsp/expert/releases and put `expert` on the PATH

elixir-ls.name: ElixirLS
elixir-ls.install: brew install elixir-ls, or download a release from https://github.com/elixir-lsp/elixir-ls/releases and unzip it to ~/.elixir-ls/release

settings.elixirLS.mixEnv.description: ElixirLS: the Mix environment it builds the project in (MIX_ENV)

settings.elixirLS.mixTarget.description: ElixirLS: the Mix target it builds for (MIX_TARGET)

settings.elixirLS.projectDir.description: ElixirLS: the folder of the Mix project within the workspace, when it is not at its top; empty for the top

settings.elixirLS.autoBuild.description: ElixirLS: build the project when a file is saved, its errors shown as diagnostics

settings.elixirLS.fetchDeps.description: ElixirLS: fetch the project's dependencies (mix deps.get) when they are missing or out of date

settings.elixirLS.dialyzerEnabled.description: ElixirLS: run Dialyzer after a build, its warnings shown as diagnostics (off here: its first run takes minutes)

settings.elixirLS.incrementalDialyzer.description: ElixirLS: Dialyzer's incremental mode (OTP 26 and later), much faster after the first run

settings.elixirLS.dialyzerFormat.description: ElixirLS: how Dialyzer's warnings read: Dialyxir's long or short messages, or Dialyzer's own

settings.elixirLS.dialyzerWarnOpts.description: ElixirLS: Dialyzer's warning options (its -W flags), for more warnings or fewer

settings.elixirLS.suggestSpecs.description: ElixirLS: offer a @spec, from what Dialyzer infers, above a function without one

settings.elixirLS.signatureAfterComplete.description: ElixirLS: show a function's signature after completing its name

settings.elixirLS.autoInsertRequiredAlia.description: ElixirLS: add the alias a completed module needs

settings.elixirLS.additionalWatchedExten.description: ElixirLS: more file extensions whose changes rebuild the project, such as .yml

settings.elixirLS.envVariables.description: ElixirLS: environment variables for its builds, as a JSON table

settings.elixirLS.stdlibSrcDir.description: ElixirLS: the Elixir sources, for going to the definitions of the standard library; empty for none
